title: Can you solve the locker riddle? - Lisa Winer
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】你能解開置物櫃之謎嗎？ - 麗莎·維納（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Your rich, eccentric uncle just passed away, and you and your 99 nasty relatives have been invited to the reading of his will.
cues.en: Your rich, eccentric uncle just passed away, and you and your 99 nasty relatives have been invited to the reading of his will.
cues.zh: 你那個富有、古怪的叔叔剛去世， 你和你 99 個卑劣的親戚 被邀請去聽他的遺囑宣讀。

cues.text: He wanted to leave all of his money to you, but he knew that if he did, your relatives would pester you forever.
cues.en: He wanted to leave all of his money to you, but he knew that if he did, your relatives would pester you forever.
cues.zh: 你和你 99 個卑劣的親戚 被邀請去聽他的遺囑宣讀。 他想把所有的錢都留給你， 可是，他知道如果這樣做， 你的親戚們會一直騷擾你。

cues.text: So he is banking on the fact that he taught you everything you need to know about riddles.
cues.en: So he is banking on the fact that he taught you everything you need to know about riddles.
cues.zh: 可是，他知道如果這樣做， 你的親戚們會一直騷擾你。 因此，他指望 他教過你所有你需要知道 關於謎語的資訊。

cues.text: Your uncle left the following note in his will: "I have created a puzzle.
cues.en: Your uncle left the following note in his will: "I have created a puzzle.
cues.zh: 你的叔叔在遺囑留下了以下註記： 「我設計了一個謎題， 如果你們 100 個人能一起解答， 你們就平均分配我的遺產。

cues.text: If all 100 of you answer it together, you will share the money evenly.
cues.en: If all 100 of you answer it together, you will share the money evenly.
cues.zh: 如果你們 100 個人能一起解答， 你們就平均分配我的遺產。 但是，如果你是第一個找到模式， 並解開謎語，

cues.text: However, if you are the first to find the pattern and solve the problem
cues.en: However, if you are the first to find the pattern and solve the problem
cues.zh: 但是，如果你是第一個找到模式， 並解開謎語， 而不是經由一個個慢慢細算，

cues.text: without going through all of the leg work, you will get the entire inheritance all to yourself.
cues.en: without going through all of the leg work, you will get the entire inheritance all to yourself.
cues.zh: 而不是經由一個個慢慢細算， 你將會得到全部的遺產。 祝你好運。」

cues.text: Good luck." The lawyer takes you and your 99 relatives to a secret room in the mansion
cues.en: Good luck." The lawyer takes you and your 99 relatives to a secret room in the mansion
cues.zh: 你將會得到全部的遺產。 祝你好運。」 律師帶你和你的 99 個親戚 去一座公寓裡的密室， 裡面有 100 個櫃子，

cues.text: that contains 100 lockers, each hiding a single word.
cues.en: that contains 100 lockers, each hiding a single word.
cues.zh: 裡面有 100 個櫃子， 每個藏有一個字。

cues.text: He explains: Every relative is assigned a number from 1 to 100.
cues.en: He explains: Every relative is assigned a number from 1 to 100.
cues.zh: 他解釋： 「每個親戚會分配到 1 至 100 中一個數字。 一號繼承人會開啟所有櫃子，

cues.text: Heir 1 will open every locker.
cues.en: Heir 1 will open every locker.
cues.zh: 一號繼承人會開啟所有櫃子， 之後，二號繼承人會把 每個 2 的倍數的櫃子關上。

cues.text: Heir 2 will then close every second locker.
cues.en: Heir 2 will then close every second locker.
cues.zh: 一號繼承人會開啟所有櫃子， 之後，二號繼承人會把 每個 2 的倍數的櫃子關上。

cues.text: Heir 3 will change the status of every third locker,
cues.en: Heir 3 will change the status of every third locker,
cues.zh: 之後，二號繼承人會把 每個 2 的倍數的櫃子關上。 三號繼承人會把 每個 3 的倍數的櫃子的狀態反轉， 明確地說， 如果本來是開著，她會關上它，

cues.text: specifically if it's open, she'll close it, but if it's closed, she'll open it.
cues.en: specifically if it's open, she'll close it, but if it's closed, she'll open it.
cues.zh: 明確地說， 如果本來是開著，她會關上它， 但如果本來是關著，她會開啟它。

cues.text: This pattern will continue until all 100 of you have gone.
cues.en: This pattern will continue until all 100 of you have gone.
cues.zh: 這方式會繼續，直到你們 100 個人都做完。 最後保持開著的櫃子裡的字

cues.text: The words in the lockers that remain open at the end will help you crack the code for the safe.
cues.en: The words in the lockers that remain open at the end will help you crack the code for the safe.
cues.zh: 最後保持開著的櫃子裡的字 會幫助你破解保險箱密碼。」 在你表哥 Thaddeus 開始排隊之前，

cues.text: Before cousin Thaddeus can even start down the line,
cues.en: Before cousin Thaddeus can even start down the line,
cues.zh: 在你表哥 Thaddeus 開始排隊之前， 你驅前告訴律師 你知道哪幾個櫃子最後仍然開著。

cues.text: you step forward and tell the lawyer you know which lockers will remain open.
cues.en: you step forward and tell the lawyer you know which lockers will remain open.
cues.zh: 在你表哥 Thaddeus 開始排隊之前， 你驅前告訴律師 你知道哪幾個櫃子最後仍然開著。

cues.text: But how?
cues.en: But how?
cues.zh: 你驅前告訴律師 你知道哪幾個櫃子最後仍然開著。 但是，如何知道的？

cues.text: Pause the video now if you want to figure it out for yourself!
cues.en: Pause the video now if you want to figure it out for yourself!
cues.zh: 如果你想自己找出答案， 你可以現在暫停影片！ 答案揭曉：3

cues.text: Answer in: 3 Answer in: 2 Answer in: 1
cues.en: Answer in: 3 Answer in: 2 Answer in: 1
cues.zh: 如果你想自己找出答案， 你可以現在暫停影片！ 答案揭曉：3 答案揭曉：2 答案揭曉：1 關鍵是要瞭解一個櫃子被觸碰的次數

cues.text: The key is realizing that the number of times a locker is touched
cues.en: The key is realizing that the number of times a locker is touched
cues.zh: 關鍵是要瞭解一個櫃子被觸碰的次數

cues.text: is the same as the number of factors in the locker number.
cues.en: is the same as the number of factors in the locker number.
cues.zh: 關鍵是要瞭解一個櫃子被觸碰的次數 等於櫃子編號的因子數目。 例如，在 6 號櫃子，

cues.text: For example, in locker #6, Person 1 will open it,
cues.en: For example, in locker #6, Person 1 will open it,
cues.zh: 例如，在 6 號櫃子， 第 1 個人會開啟， 第 2 個人會把它關上，

cues.text: Person 2 will close it, Person 3 will open it,
cues.en: Person 2 will close it, Person 3 will open it,
cues.zh: 第 2 個人會把它關上， 第 3 個人會再開啟， 第 6 個人會把它關上。

cues.text: and Person 6 will close it.
cues.en: and Person 6 will close it.
cues.zh: 第 6 個人會把它關上。 數字 1、2、3、6 都是 6 的因子，

cues.text: The numbers 1, 2, 3, and 6 are the factors of 6.
cues.en: The numbers 1, 2, 3, and 6 are the factors of 6.
cues.zh: 第 6 個人會把它關上。 數字 1、2、3、6 都是 6 的因子，

cues.text: So when a locker has an even number of factors it will remain closed,
cues.en: So when a locker has an even number of factors it will remain closed,
cues.zh: 數字 1、2、3、6 都是 6 的因子， 所以當櫃子編號有偶數個因子時， 最後會保持關著，

cues.text: and when it has an odd number of factors, it will remain open.
cues.en: and when it has an odd number of factors, it will remain open.
cues.zh: 最後會保持關著， 而當它有奇數個因子時， 它會保持開著。

cues.text: Most of the lockers have an even number of factors, which makes sense because factors naturally pair up.
cues.en: Most of the lockers have an even number of factors, which makes sense because factors naturally pair up.
cues.zh: 它會保持開著。 大部分的櫃子編號都有偶數個因子， 這是合理的，因為因子本來就是配對。

cues.text: In fact, the only lockers that have an odd number of factors
cues.en: In fact, the only lockers that have an odd number of factors
cues.zh: 這是合理的，因為因子本來就是配對。 事實上，只有奇數個因子的櫃子編號

cues.text: are perfect squares because those have one factor that when multiplied by itself equals the number.
cues.en: are perfect squares because those have one factor that when multiplied by itself equals the number.
cues.zh: 事實上，只有奇數個因子的櫃子編號 都是完全平方數， 因為那些有一個因子是自己相乘等於櫃子編號。

cues.text: For Locker 9, 1 will open it, 3 will close,
cues.en: For Locker 9, 1 will open it, 3 will close,
cues.zh: 因為那些有一個因子是自己相乘等於櫃子編號。 以 9 號櫃子為例，一號繼承人會開啟它， 三號會關上它， 而九號會開啟它。

cues.text: and 9 will open it.
cues.en: and 9 will open it.
cues.zh: 而九號會開啟它。 3 x 3 = 9,

cues.text: 3 x 3 = 9, but the 3 can only be counted once.
cues.en: 3 x 3 = 9, but the 3 can only be counted once.
cues.zh: 而九號會開啟它。 3 x 3 = 9, 但 3 只能被算一次。

cues.text: Therefore, every locker that is a perfect square will remain open.
cues.en: Therefore, every locker that is a perfect square will remain open.
cues.zh: 所以，完全平方數的櫃子 最後都會保持開啟。 你知道這 10 個櫃子就是答案，

cues.text: You know that these ten lockers are the solution, so you open them immediately and read the words inside:
cues.en: You know that these ten lockers are the solution, so you open them immediately and read the words inside:
cues.zh: 你知道這 10 個櫃子就是答案， 所以你立刻開啟它們，並讀裡面的字： 「密碼是首五個只被觸碰兩次的櫃子。」

cues.text: "The code is the first five lockers touched only twice."
cues.en: "The code is the first five lockers touched only twice."
cues.zh: 所以你立刻開啟它們，並讀裡面的字： 「密碼是首五個只被觸碰兩次的櫃子。」

cues.text: You realize that the only lockers touched twice have to be prime numbers
cues.en: You realize that the only lockers touched twice have to be prime numbers
cues.zh: 「密碼是首五個只被觸碰兩次的櫃子。」 你知道只被觸碰兩次的櫃子 必須是質數，

cues.text: since each only has two factors: 1 and itself.
cues.en: since each only has two factors: 1 and itself.
cues.zh: 你知道只被觸碰兩次的櫃子 必須是質數， 因為每個只有兩個因子： 1 和那數字本身。 所以密碼是 2 - 3 - 5 - 7 - 11。

cues.text: So the code is 2-3-5-7-11.
cues.en: So the code is 2-3-5-7-11.
cues.zh: 所以密碼是 2 - 3 - 5 - 7 - 11。 那個律師帶你到保險箱，

cues.text: The lawyer brings you to the safe, and you claim your inheritance.
cues.en: The lawyer brings you to the safe, and you claim your inheritance.
cues.zh: 那個律師帶你到保險箱， 你宣告瞭你的遺產權。

cues.text: Too bad your relatives were always too busy being nasty to each other to pay attention to your eccentric uncle's riddles.
cues.en: Too bad your relatives were always too busy being nasty to each other to pay attention to your eccentric uncle's riddles.
cues.zh: 你宣告瞭你的遺產權。 可惜你的親戚 一直忙於惡劣地彼此對待， 以致無法專注於你古怪叔叔的謎語。
